# bugs #4163: Struct initializers that are conditional expressions with operands of the form *p get wrong bytes

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/4163/
- Category: [Fixes](../../fix.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17193
- Recommended action: Apply the patch for #4131 and close.
- Patch: [bugs-4131.patch](../../patches/bugs-4131.patch), commit [`695ce6c16`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/695ce6c16dc4935da000dc61b74c23eff8c04764). Apply after `bugs-4157-1.patch`, `bugs-3121.patch`, `bugs-3847.patch`, `bugs-3849.patch`.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The initializer of the ticket, `point room2 = room ? *room : *RoomGet ();`, gives wrong bytes on
r17193 for mcs51, stm8, and z80. Conditional expressions with the operands `*p`, `a[i]`, and `p[1]`
of struct type do so as well. Of the 16 assertions of `support/regression/tests/bug-4163.c`, 12
fail for mcs51-large, and 14 fail for mcs51-small, mcs51-small-stack-auto, mcs51-large-stack-auto,
stm8, and ucz80.

## Cause

`geniCodeConditional` in `src/SDCCicode.c` evaluates the second and the third operand as values.
An operand `*p` or `a[i]` of struct type is read through its address as a scalar, and the bytes
that were read are used as the address of the value. The entry for #4131 describes the second
fault of the function, which concerns the kind of that address.

## Fix

With the patch for #4131, `geniCodeConditional` evaluates both operands in the way the operand of
`&` is evaluated, and it selects between two generic pointers.

The patch for #4054 removes the read of a struct from `geniCodeDerefPtr`. Without the patch for
#4131, it corrects the initializer of the ticket and leaves one form of the test wrong for
mcs51-large-stack-auto.

## Verification

With the patch for #4131 and without the patch for #4054, `bug-4163.c` passes on the host, for the
six mcs51 variants, for stm8, and for ucz80.

With the patch for #4054 and without the patch for #4131, the test passes for mcs51-small,
mcs51-large, mcs51-small-stack-auto, stm8, and ucz80. For mcs51-large-stack-auto the four
assertions on `c ? rooms[i] : p[1]` fail. The host, mcs51-medium, and mcs51-huge were not run with
this combination.

## Related

- #4131 has the patch. The first comment of this ticket expects the patch in the third comment of
  #4131 to correct this case. That patch was read and was not built.
- #3857 reports the same fault for an assignment.
- #4054 reports the read through the pointer for arguments of the form `*p`.
